name: Sign Rank / Star Number (Affine Incomparable)
details: Both affine directions fail, but sign rank is bounded by a finite-valued function of star number (relationship sign_rank_star_number_functional_upper). This is not functional incomparability; the reverse functional bound fails.
parameter_1_larger_witness: On #classes/parity_functions, SR>=2^n while star number is exactly 2n, yielding an unbounded ratio.
parameter_2_larger_witness: On #classes/singletons_plus_empty_set with n>=4, star number is n while sign rank is three, excluding even reverse functional control.
proof_source: Survey cor:signrank-parity-separations and database-owned endpoint proofs.
